Indeed / Job Portal Posting \| Machine Operator \- Activated Carbon Manufacturing

**Machine Operator \- Granulation / Rotary Kiln / Post\-Activation Machines**

*Location: Carbonmax Factory, Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, Tirupur District, Tamil Nadu*

**Company**

Carbonmax Advantech Pvt Ltd

**Job Title**

Machine Operator \- Activated Carbon Manufacturing

**Machine Areas**

Granulation / Rotary Kiln Activation / Post\-Activation / Screening / Packing Support

**Department**

Production / Operations

**Work Location**

Factory at Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, Tirupur District, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type**

Full\-time, factory\-based role; shift work applicable

**Experience**

Minimum 2 to 8 years preferred in process plant, kiln, furnace, dryer, crusher, screening, packing, chemical, mineral, foundry, boiler, cement, textile processing, or similar manufacturing operations. Fresh ITI / Diploma candidates with good attitude may also be considered for trainee operator roles.

**Qualification**

ITI / Diploma / 10th or 12th pass with relevant industrial machine operating experience

**Reporting To**

Shift In\-Charge / Production Supervisor / Production Manager

**Joining**

Immediate or early joiners preferred

About Carbonmax

Carbonmax Advantech Pvt Ltd is engaged in coconut shell based steam activated carbon manufacturing for domestic and export markets. The factory is located at Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, and is being developed with a strong focus on safe operations, disciplined production, quality consistency, cleanliness, training, and audit\-ready factory standards.

Job Summary

We are looking for disciplined and hardworking Machine Operators to operate and support production machinery used in coconut shell based steam activated carbon manufacturing. The role includes machine operation in granulation, rotary kiln activation, post\-activation processing, screening, packing support, material handling, basic machine cleaning, shift reporting, safety compliance, and maintaining production areas in clean and organized condition.

Key Responsibilities1\. Granulation / Crushing / Screening Operations

· Operate granulators, crushers, vibro screens, conveyors, bucket elevators, magnetic separators, dust collection systems, and related production equipment as instructed.

· Feed coconut shell charcoal / activated carbon material safely into machines as per production plan and supervisor instruction.

· Monitor product size, feed rate, material flow, screen condition, dust generation, abnormal sound, vibration, blockage, and machine performance during operation.

· Assist in changeover of mesh sizes, screens, bags, bins, hoppers, and related accessories as per grade requirement.

· Avoid material contamination, mix\-up, spillage, and unnecessary wastage during production.

2\. Rotary Kiln Activation Support

· Support operation of rotary kiln activation section under the instruction of Shift In\-Charge / Production Supervisor.

· Assist in feeding, kiln discharge monitoring, cooler operation, material movement, and safe handling of hot activated carbon as per SOP.

· Observe and report abnormal temperature, smoke, flame pattern, steam line issue, material choking, unusual sound, leakage, or unsafe condition immediately.

· Support routine cleaning around kiln, cooler, snout, discharge area, conveyors, and production floor to maintain safe and dust\-controlled operations.

· Strictly follow lockout, hot work, confined area, and equipment safety instructions whenever applicable.

3\. Post\-Activation Machine Operations

· Operate post\-activation machines such as destoner, screens, crushers, classifiers, elevators, conveyors, packing machines, and support equipment as assigned.

· Ensure activated carbon is processed as per grade, mesh size, customer requirement, and production instruction.

· Coordinate with QC / lab team for sample collection, batch identification, hold material, rejected material, and approved material movement.

· Maintain separation of different grades, batches, mesh sizes, and customer\-specific materials to prevent mix\-up.

· Support final screening, demagnetization, weighing, bagging, palletizing, and dispatch preparation when required.

4\. Production Discipline \& Shift Reporting

· Follow daily production plan and instructions given by Production Manager, Shift In\-Charge, or Department In\-Charge.

· Maintain basic machine log sheets including running hours, stoppage, breakdown, cleaning time, production quantity, rework, wastage, and observations.

· Report machine breakdowns, abnormal performance, quality issues, safety incidents, and material shortages immediately.

· Hand over the machine and production status properly to the next shift operator.

· Support supervisors in achieving production targets with quality, safety, and housekeeping discipline.

5\. Safety, Housekeeping \& 5S

· Wear required PPE such as safety shoes, helmet, gloves, mask / respirator, goggles, ear protection, and uniform as instructed.

· Maintain assigned machine area clean, dust\-controlled, organized, and audit\-ready at all times.

· Follow safety rules for rotating machines, hot material, dust, electrical panels, compressed air, conveyors, forklifts, and material handling equipment.

· Clean spillage immediately and keep pathways, emergency access, fire points, and electrical areas free from obstruction.

· Participate in toolbox talks, safety training, machine training, 5S activities, and continuous improvement practices.

6\. Maintenance Support

· Carry out basic machine cleaning, tightening observation, lubrication support, screen inspection, belt tracking observation, and minor routine checks as instructed.

· Inform maintenance team promptly about abnormal noise, belt slippage, bearing heating, loose parts, leakage, vibration, electrical issue, or mechanical damage.

· Assist maintenance team during shutdown, preventive maintenance, screen replacement, cleaning, trial run, and machine restart activities.

· Do not operate unsafe or defective equipment without supervisor clearance.

Required Skills \& Competencies

· Practical experience in operating industrial machinery in a manufacturing or process plant environment.

· Ability to follow SOPs, supervisor instructions, safety rules, and production discipline.

· Basic understanding of machine running condition, sound, vibration, heat, flow, choking, and maintenance warning signs.

· Willingness to work in shifts and in a rural factory environment.

· Good physical fitness for factory work, material handling support, standing, walking, cleaning, and machine monitoring.

· Ability to maintain cleanliness, avoid contamination, and work with quality consciousness.

· Teamwork, punctuality, honesty, discipline, and willingness to learn activated carbon manufacturing operations.

Preferred Candidate Profile

· Candidates from activated carbon, charcoal processing, chemical plant, cement, mineral processing, foundry, boiler, dryer, kiln, furnace, textile processing, food processing, or similar industries will be preferred.

· ITI Fitter / Electrician / Welder / Mechanical / Production trade candidates with machine operating experience are preferred.

· Candidates who can relocate or commute reliably to Ponnapuram Village / Dharapuram / nearby areas are preferred.

· Candidates with forklift, pallet trolley, basic maintenance, packing, weighing, or dispatch support experience will have an added advantage.

Education \& Experience

· **Education:** ITI / Diploma / 10th / 12th pass with relevant factory machine operating experience.

· **Experience:** 2 to 5 years preferred in machine operation. Freshers may be considered for trainee roles based on attitude and learning ability.

· **Language:** Tamil preferred. Basic Hindi / English understanding will be an added advantage.

· **Computer Knowledge:** Not mandatory. Basic ability to fill log sheets and production records is required.

Work Conditions

· Factory\-based role at Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk.

· Shift duty and overtime may be applicable as per production requirement.

· Work involves dust\-prone process areas, rotating machinery, hot material zones, conveyors, screens, and material handling areas.

· Strict PPE, safety, hygiene, and housekeeping rules must be followed.

Why Join Carbonmax?

· Opportunity to work in a growing coconut shell based activated carbon manufacturing company.

· Hands\-on training in granulation, rotary kiln activation, post\-activation, screening, and packing operations.

· Professional factory culture focused on safety, cleanliness, discipline, quality, and continuous improvement.

· Long\-term career growth opportunity for sincere and hardworking operators.

Interested candidates may apply with their updated resume, present salary, expected salary, notice period, current location, and details of machines previously operated. Candidates should be willing to work at Carbonmax factory located in Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, Tirupur District, Tamil Nadu.

Job Portal Posting \| Lab Chemist \- Quality Control / Activated Carbon Testing

**Lab Chemist \- Quality Control / Activated Carbon Manufacturing**

*Location: Carbonmax Factory, Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, Tirupur District, Tamil Nadu*

**Company**

Carbonmax Advantech Pvt Ltd

**Job Title**

Lab Chemist \- Quality Control / Activated Carbon Testing

**Department**

Quality Control / Quality Assurance Laboratory

**Work Location**

Factory at Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, Tirupur District, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type**

Full\-time, factory\-based role

**Experience**

Minimum 2 to 5 years preferred in chemical, carbon, water treatment, food, pharma, minerals, cement, textile processing, or related process industry laboratories

**Qualification**

B.Sc. Chemistry / M.Sc. Chemistry / Diploma or Degree in Chemical Technology / Applied Chemistry or equivalent

**Reporting To**

QA/QC Manager / Quality Head / Plant Head

**Joining**

Immediate or early joiners preferred

About Carbonmax

Carbonmax Advantech Pvt Ltd is engaged in coconut shell based steam activated carbon manufacturing for domestic and export markets. The factory is located at Ponnapuram Village, Dharapuram Taluk, and is being developed with a strong focus on quality systems, process discipline, laboratory testing, product consistency, safety, cleanliness, and audit\-ready operations.

Job Summary

We are looking for a sincere and technically strong Lab Chemist to support routine quality testing, process control testing, finished goods inspection, documentation, and laboratory discipline for coconut shell based steam activated carbon manufacturing. The candidate should be willing to work in a rural factory environment and support the QA/QC team with accurate testing, timely reporting, proper sample handling, and strict adherence to laboratory procedures.

Key Responsibilities1\. Laboratory Testing \& Analysis

· Carry out routine testing of coconut shell charcoal, in\-process activated carbon, finished activated carbon, and value\-added carbon samples.

· Perform testing for key activated carbon parameters such as iodine value, CTC activity, moisture, ash, pH, apparent density, hardness, particle size / mesh analysis, water soluble ash, acid soluble ash, and other required parameters as per internal SOPs.

· Support testing for acid washed, water washed, powdered, granular, and specialty activated carbon grades as required.

· Prepare reagents, standard solutions, indicators, and laboratory consumables as per approved methods.

· Ensure tests are completed accurately within the required turnaround time for production release and dispatch planning.

2\. Sampling \& Sample Management

· Collect and receive samples from raw material, activation, post\-activation, screening, packing, and dispatch areas as per sampling plan.

· Maintain proper sample identification, batch numbering, retention samples, and sample storage records.

· Coordinate with production, stores, packing, and dispatch teams for timely sample collection and result communication.

· Avoid sample mix\-up by following proper labelling, sealing, and documentation procedures.

3\. Quality Documentation \& Reporting

· Record test results accurately in laboratory registers, worksheets, ERP / Excel formats, and quality reports.

· Prepare daily test reports, batch\-wise quality reports, and internal quality summaries for review by the QA/QC Manager.

· Support preparation of Certificate of Analysis inputs and batch release data under the guidance of the Quality Head.

· Maintain calibration records, reagent preparation records, equipment usage logs, sample registers, and housekeeping checklists.

· Immediately report any abnormal result, deviation, repeat test, or out\-of\-specification observation to the QA/QC Manager.

4\. Laboratory Equipment \& Calibration

· Operate and maintain laboratory equipment such as ovens, muffle furnace, pH meter, weighing balance, mechanical sieve shaker, hardness tester, glassware, titration setup, and other testing instruments.

· Perform routine verification and basic calibration checks as per laboratory schedule.

· Ensure instruments are clean, labelled, maintained, and used only as per SOP.

· Report instrument breakdowns, abnormal readings, and maintenance requirements promptly.

5\. Factory Quality Support

· Support production quality monitoring during granulation, activation, cooling, destoning, crushing, screening, post\-activation, packing, and dispatch stages.

· Help identify variation in raw charcoal quality, activation output, particle size distribution, hardness, ash, and other quality parameters.

· Support corrective actions and re\-testing when quality deviation is observed.

· Coordinate with shift in\-charges and department teams to ensure samples are tested and communicated without delay.

6\. Safety, Cleanliness \& Laboratory Discipline

· Follow laboratory safety rules while handling acids, alkalis, chemicals, hot equipment, glassware, and sample materials.

· Maintain the laboratory in clean, organized, audit\-ready condition at all times.

· Use PPE such as lab coat, gloves, goggles, safety shoes, and mask wherever required.

· Ensure proper chemical storage, labelling, disposal, and segregation of laboratory waste.

· Follow 5S, housekeeping, and safety discipline expected in a professional manufacturing factory.

Required Skills \& Competencies

· Good practical knowledge of wet chemistry, titration, weighing, sample preparation, and analytical calculations.

· Ability to follow SOPs and standard test methods with discipline and repeatability.

· Basic knowledge of laboratory safety, chemical handling, and documentation practices.

· Good numerical ability, observation skills, and attention to detail.

· Basic computer knowledge including MS Excel, data entry, report preparation, and email communication.

· Ability to work with production and QA/QC teams in a factory environment.

· High integrity in reporting results without manipulation or shortcuts.

· Willingness to work in Ponnapuram Village / Dharapuram factory location.

Preferred Industry Background

· Activated carbon / carbon products / charcoal processing industry.

· Chemical manufacturing or process industry laboratory.

· Water treatment chemicals, minerals, food ingredients, pharma, cement, textile processing, or environmental laboratory.

· Experience in ISO\-based documentation, quality systems, and customer audit support will be an added advantage.

Candidate Profile

**Education**

B.Sc. Chemistry / M.Sc. Chemistry / Diploma or Degree in Chemical Technology / Applied Chemistry or equivalent

**Experience**

2 to 5 years preferred; freshers with strong chemistry knowledge and factory willingness may also be considered for junior roles

**Age Group**

Preferably 23 to 35 years, flexible for suitable candidates

**Language**

Tamil required; basic English preferred for documentation and reporting

**Computer Skills**

MS Excel, email, basic ERP/data entry knowledge preferred

**Work Nature**

Factory\-based laboratory role; may involve shift support depending on production requirements

What We Expect from the Candidate

· Be punctual, disciplined, sincere, and quality\-focused.

· Maintain accurate records and support transparent quality reporting.

· Keep the laboratory clean, organized, and inspection\-ready.

· Understand the importance of quality consistency for export customers.

· Work respectfully with production, packing, stores, dispatch, and management teams.

· Be willing to learn activated carbon testing methods and grow with the company.

Why Join Carbonmax

· Opportunity to work in a growing activated carbon manufacturing company with export focus.

· Exposure to coconut shell based steam activated carbon production and advanced quality testing.

· Structured factory environment with scope for long\-term career growth in QA/QC.

· Opportunity to learn international quality expectations for activated carbon applications.

· Stable factory\-based employment in the Dharapuram / Tirupur region.

Compensation

Salary will be based on qualification, experience, technical knowledge, laboratory exposure, and suitability for the role. Food, accommodation, transport, or other support may be considered as per company policy and candidate suitability.

**Job Description**
* An accomplished HR Full\-Scope Generalist who has experience in human resources in the area of staffing, organizational interventions, compensation and benefits, organization development, employee relations, training and knowledge of Statutory compliance.
* In\-depth knowledge and understanding of good practices in HR management, particularly with respect to: Recruitment and resourcing; Compensation and reward; Learning and talent management; Employee Relation; Organizational planning and change. Successful track record of initiating People strategies to support business growth and change.
* Demonstrated strategic thinking, understanding of business and execution excellence.
* Strong capability in managing dynamic and matrix relations with different stakeholders. Excellent influencing, communication and presentation skills.
* Leadership building/management (at all levels), strong business connectivity and influencing skills working  with senior leaders and partnering with Honeywell HR consul, lead employee consultation and communication effectively.
* Result orientation with high productivity; strong desire for success.


**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Organization Development \- Strong HR Knowledge of organizational development \-Alignment of organizational processes, systems and culture with key business priorities, design optimal organizational structures, understand organization and cultural needs and drive change management.
* Exposure to Learning Content Design \& Delivery, capable of independent team interventions for achieving specific results.
* Talent Development \-Manage key Process and people .Own Talent development and execution, drive key talent retention \& development efforts, ensure successful on boarding including orientation and new manager assimilation.
* Coaching Strong ability to provide coaching/ counseling to both employees and business leaders in performance reviews, performance improvement plans, identification of key talent and other areas of employee management.
* HR Reporting \& Analysis \-Report, track, manage and analyze census for area of responsibility. Validate integrity of job and comp data. Exposure to PeS preferred.
* Compensation Consultation \-Drive consistent comp practices with managers including annual Compensation revision consultation, benchmarking all offers and promotions.
* Staffing \-Assist in staffing delivery and drive success of shared staffing solutions, assist manager in talent selection and follow process and practice as defined by staffing COE.
* Benefits \-Communicate benefits policies to managers and employees provide specialist intervention as required. Manage HR processes, policies, and procedures.
* Employee Rewards \-Manage eligibility \& process for incentive plans, progression, and R\&R programs Communication \-Ensure and/or develop and deliver business communications and communicate HR policies.
* Business and Strategic Partnering \-Contribute to the development and accomplishment of organization\-wide business plan and objectives. Knowledge about design of work systems in which people succeed and contribute. Business oriented thinking and approach, knowledge of finance and accounting to be able to appreciate business deliverables. Accountable and responsible for HR cost rationalization and measurement of all HR programs and processes.
* Labour and Site Compliances: The person should have basic knowledge to manage the labour and site compliances and adhere to local laws and regulations.


**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**
* Preferably an MBA from a reputed institute, majoring in HR
* At least 4\- 8 yrs years of experience in the HR domain with appropriate experience in the HR generalist function in   good MNC organizations.
* Drive organizational effectiveness
* Lead change
* Manage talent
* Build relationships and broker services
* Act as a coach and confidant
* Administrative support
* Lead training and development


**WE VALUE**
* Some Human Resources experience
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to influence at varying levels across the organization
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and navigate in a highly matrixed environment
* Individuals who are self\-motivated and able to work with little supervision, who consistently take the initiative to get things done, do things before being asked by others or forced to by events.


 Ability to artfully convey even subtle or complex messages clearly, as appropriate for the topic and audience.

title: Associate Talent Manager
description:
**Position Summary**
 This position is responsible for managing the ILM artists within their designated department(s) with the support and guidance of the Senior Talent Managers/Director of Talent. This role also works closely with Producers, Studio Production Manager and others as appropriate to schedule artists to ensure proper casting as well as timely and efficient completion of projects.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* In conjunction with Sr Talent Manager(s) \- manage artist crewing and scheduling for specific departments. Responsible for the artists day to day in regards to queries, absence, performance, timecards, annual reviews, career progression, next show opportunities and contract extensions.
* Working closely with the Sr Talent Manager(s)/ Director of Talent and HR when people issues arise and escalating these effectively.
* Through weekly CG Status meetings and department specific meetings, maintains regular contact with Shows to ensure that crewing needs are met.
* Maintains overview of utilisation using established departmental production management and tracking systems.
* Working closely with the Sr Talent Manager(s), maintains an overall schedule for digital artists. Creates \- and maintains scheduling overviews and availability schedules upon request.
* Determines and projects current and future project\-based personnel needs based on input from Studio Production Manager, Sr Talent Manager(s) and Production. This includes maintaining contact with Producers regarding overall crew size requirements, crew start and end dates and show start/delivery dates as well as incorporating bidding data into facility projections. Flags potential problems in regards to any of these.
* Works collaboratively with Production, Supervisors and Recruitment to define and communicate ongoing recruitment requirements for assigned departments.
* Works closely with Sr Talent Manager(s) and Department HOD in relation to artist management, casting and people development
* Special projects as needed on an on\-going basis as assigned


****What we’re looking for****
* Previous experience in VFX industry in a scheduling or other relevant role or other high\-end computer graphics production environment preferred
* Proven experience of people/artist management
* Knowledge of computer graphics terminology and a thorough understanding of the processes involved in CG post production
* Demonstrate the ability to learn quickly
* High levels of self\-motivation and proactiveness as well as reactiveness
* Demonstrable ability to interact well with groups of individuals with different personalities, perspectives and talents
* Proven analytical skills, effective scheduling and time management abilities
* Proactive and pragmatic approach to problem\-solving with an ability to create process and useful data with ambiguous information
* Excellent administrative, organizational, interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal)
* Computer skills: Microsoft Word, Excel, Google Suite
* Must be able to work quickly and effectively to turn around reports and analysis in a timely manner

APM Terminals

**Lead HR Processes**

* Support the rollout of new HR systems and processes (Workday \& ServiceNow)


**Support Employees**

* Resolve employee relations matters
* Ensure compliance with employment laws and site\-level statutory requirements


**Drive Talent \& Workforce Planning**

* Support hiring, onboarding, training, and engagement activities
* Encourage internal mobility and growth opportunities for employees


**Collaborate Across HR**
* Partner with HRBPs, People Advisory, Centres of Excellence, and Global Mobility teams
* Work with regional People Partnering Operations (PPO) to solve complex cases


**What We’re Looking For:**
 To succeed in this role, you should bring:
   

  

* 10–12 years of HR generalist experience
* Strong understanding of: ✔ Employee relations ✔ Labour laws ✔ Performance \& talent processes ✔ Vendor management
* Experience working with large or multinational organizations
* Ability to coach leaders, handle change, and work independently
* A positive, energetic, “let’s find a solution” mindset
* Strong communication skills in English and local language


 Experience in unionized environments is a bonus.
   

  

**Why Join Maersk?**
 When you join Maersk, you become part of a global business that moves
 **20% of the world’s trade** 
 .
   

  

 We value diversity, collaboration, and growth—and we put our people at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

 You will get:
   

  

* A chance to influence key people decisions
* Opportunities to work with global teams
* Exposure to complex business operations
* Long\-term career and learning opportunities
* The satisfaction of making a real difference on the ground


 Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. title: HR Manager – Training & Development
description:
**HR Manager – Training \& Development** 




**Organisation:** 
 The Language SKOOL
 



**Location:** 
 Remote – India
 



**Experience:** 
 15\+ Years (Majority in Training \& Development Leadership)
 



**Salary:** 
 Upto 12 Lakhs (based on experience)
 



**Reporting To:** 
 HR Director
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**About The Language SKOOL** 




 The Language SKOOL (TLS) is a fast\-growing, remote\-first EdTech organisation with 500\+ team members across academic, sales, operations, digital marketing, and support functions. We are a performance\-driven organisation committed to structured systems, strong people processes, and continuous capability building.
 



 As we scale, we are strengthening our Learning \& Development ecosystem to build future\-ready leaders, high\-performing trainers, and empowered functional teams.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a
 **Senior HR Manager – Training \& Development** 
 who will exclusively own the organisation\-wide Learning \& Development function for:
 


* Language Trainers (Multiple Language Verticals )
* Sales, Operations, Digital Marketing, HR, Accounts, Legal and Support teams



 This is a
 **strategic leadership role** 
 , responsible for building a structured, measurable, and scalable T\&D framework aligned with organisational growth, revenue goals, and performance standards.
 



 The role requires deep expertise in instructional design, capability mapping, leadership development, and performance\-linked training interventions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic L\&D Planning** 



* Design and implement the annual Training \& Development roadmap.
* Align training strategy with business growth plans and departmental KPIs.
* Create capability frameworks for trainers and non\-trainer roles.
* Partner with leadership to forecast future skill requirements.



**2\. Trainer Development Framework** 



* Build structured Train\-the\-Trainer programs.
* Standardise teaching quality benchmarks across languages.
* Develop pedagogy enhancement modules.
* Introduce certification pathways and skill grading systems.
* Monitor and improve trainer effectiveness through measurable metrics.



**3\. Non\-Trainer Staff Development** 



* Design structured induction programs.
* Build leadership development tracks for mid and senior managers.
* Develop sales capability enhancement modules.
* Conduct behavioural, soft skills, and managerial effectiveness programs.
* Introduce succession planning frameworks.



**4\. Performance\-Linked Learning** 



* Integrate training outcomes with Performance Management Systems.
* Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) based on appraisal data.
* Measure ROI of training initiatives.
* Develop competency\-based assessment tools.



**5\. Content \& Program Development** 



* Develop structured training calendars (quarterly \& annual).
* Design blended learning modules (live, LMS, recorded, assessments).
* Build internal knowledge repositories and SOP learning modules.
* Standardise onboarding learning journeys.



**6\. Team \& Vendor Management** 



* Lead internal L\&D team
* Identify and collaborate with external trainers or certification partners.
* Ensure cost\-effective training budget utilisation.



**7\. Governance \& Reporting** 



* Present quarterly training impact reports to management.
* Define training metrics: productivity improvement, revenue impact, engagement, retention.
* Maintain structured training documentation and compliance records.



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



* 15\+ years of total HR experience.
* Minimum 8–10 years exclusively in Training \& Development leadership roles.
* Experience designing enterprise\-level L\&D frameworks.
* Strong exposure to strategic workforce planning.
* Proven ability to build scalable training systems in growth organisations.
* Experience in EdTech, education, services, or remote\-first organisations preferred.
* Strong presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Data\-driven and comfortable working with metrics and performance dashboards.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* A strategic thinker, not just a trainer.
* Someone who can build systems, not just conduct sessions.
* A leader who can standardise excellence across verticals.
* High ownership, structured mindset, and execution discipline.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment.



**Why Join TLS?** 



* Opportunity to design the entire Learning \& Development architecture from the ground up.
* Direct exposure to senior leadership decision\-making.
* Fully remote, structured digital ecosystem.
* High impact role with measurable organisational influence.

 – HR Support Coordinator

title: Sr. Process Analyst Human Resource Operations - Contact Center
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting embraces long\-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. In this role, you will work for IBM BPO, part of Consulting that accelerates digital transformation using agile methodologies, process mining, and AI\-powered workflows.
   

  

 You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including IBM Software and Red Hat.
   

  

 Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be supported by mentors and coaches who will encourage you to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long\-term career growth and learning opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As Senior Process Analyst – HR Contact Center, you are responsible for receiving calls, emails, or chats and resolving HR\-related queries from employees. You should be flexible to work in shifts.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Include**
* Educate and document enquirers on processes whenever necessary.
* Provide quality customer service in every interaction.
* Identify, investigate, analyse, and resolve issues identified within the process.
* Monitor and process tickets in the ticketing system.
* Provide floor support for escalation and query resolution.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Graduate/Postgraduate (MBA HR is preferred) with 3\-5 years of experience in HR Contact Centre for any International IT / ITES Company.

* Proactively anticipates potential issues, adjusts work priorities to meet evolving customer needs, and initiates follow\-ups with key customers on resolutions and action plans.
* Effectively collaborates with internal and external stakeholders and positively influences problem\-solving and process improvements.
* Demonstrates excellent customer service skills, communicating effectively across all organizational levels, and adeptly resolves challenging customer service issues.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Proficient in MS Office applications.
* Excellent communication skills in English both oral and written.
* Self\-directed and ambitious achiever, Meeting targets effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse complex data, complemented by strong interpersonal and organizational skills.

description:

title: Director, Human Resources
description:
Wherever you are in the amazing world of Disney, you are contributing to the stories of our iconic brands, recognized by audiences everywhere for entertainment, information and inspiration. Innovation, imagination and inclusion are at the core of Disney, defining the experience that we deliver as well as providing the foundation of our success. The scope of our business, combined with global growth and collaboration, result in an inclusive employee experience characterized by continuous learning, development and achievement.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 The Director, Human Resources will serve as a strategic leader for all business groups in India and will lead the India HR team that services Mumbai and Bangalore supporting DE, DEx, corporate groups and the Technology Center, Bangalore. The ideal candidate must have relevant Technology HR experience, deep people leadership experience, strong business acumen and significant Human Resource (HR) functional knowledge to guide the development of HR strategies that will attract, develop and retain the breadth of talent required to drive business transformation and success.
   

  

 This position requires an individual that can assess business situations as well as identify and implement the appropriate business, organization and / or people strategy solutions. Anticipating trends, making pro\-active recommendations, being highly influential and advocating workplace inclusion and good employee relations are critical components to the role. The Director of Human Resources works closely with HR functional teams to drive, integrate, and implement HR strategies that enable the business by creating a culture of optimism, openness and teamwork. This leader also participates on senior executive committees, interfaces with relevant external agencies and partners. He/she is responsible for developing a strategic roadmap that aligns business strategy with HR goals and initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement HR strategy for the Technology Center, supporting the goals and growth objectives of the TWDC Technology Center (aligning to global / regional TWDC Technology objectives and goals, as required).
* Serve as partner and trusted adviser to the Technology Center Leadership Team and other senior leaders in India.
* Develop, implement and integrate all human resource policies and programs
* Hire and develop team members in key human resources areas: Talent Acquisition, Organization \& Talent Solutions, HR Business Partners, Compensation \& Benefits, Employee Relations and HR Operations.
* Responsible for people initiatives that involve significant complexity and require deep HRBP and organizational transformation experience, including the ability to consult, coach and influence senior executives, lead complex change management projects and collaboratively partner at all levels, including local/regional/global stakeholders.
* Manage and lead the HR organization in India to include HR development and keep the team highly engaged. Encourage diversity of thought, ongoing development of HR team capabilities and individual talent management. Ensure HR team members are positioned as credible, proactive and trusted partners across the business.
* Partner closely with the VP, HR (APAC), APAC COEs and Segment HR to deploy and implement global and regional HR strategies and initiatives at a local level. Advise, coach and support local COE team members on the implementation of global/regional projects; maintain collaborative relationships with regional/global partners and share and leverage best practices.
* Maintain and implement compelling and engaging compensation and benefits programs (in partnership with regional C\&B lead).
* Drive talent attraction and engagement ensuring talent acquisition COE team members deliver through overseeing effective employer brand marketing campaigns; implementing talent acquisition initiatives to attract diverse technology talent; improved candidate and line management experience; and effective contingent labour practices.
* Oversee local Global HR Operations team and ensure practices aligned to local needs; coach and advise team members on specific India requirements and projects.
* Manage the headcount reporting and Cast Member Relations budget across India, working closely with the Head of Finance. Manage headcount reporting processes during AOP and LRP processes and ongoing HC/budget management movements throughout the year
* Ensure TWDC employment systems, policies and processes are compliant with all local Employment legislation, awards and laws. Closely monitor employment law changes and updates, working closely with internal (and external) legal partners on policy and process reviews and leader/employee education.
* Drive employee engagement through the delivery of effective Cast Member engagement programs, working in close partnership with Internal Communications teams. Lead global, regional and local initiatives, leveraging feedback data from Cast Member surveys as relevant.
* Responsible for senior\-level decision making and both day\-to\-day management and strategic direction of the organization
* Develop and implement an annual roadmap for HR strategy, in line with the business plan. Ensure HR plans support the needs of the business but are also flexible enough to cope with changes in the organization, as and when they occur
* Work across diverse lines of business to support HR work and coach executives on people strategies aligned with their business goals.
* Work closely with Corporate Global Security teams on Crisis Management Planning and actively participate in Crisis Management prevention planning and incident management for the Technology Center. Provide on the ground crisis management/care team support for India.


**Required Qualifications**
* 12 \+ Years of HR leadership role in a dynamic, multi\-national and matrixed environment.
* Experience in a Technology company based in India is preferred
* Track record of successfully implementing and managing best practice HR strategy, processes and systems.
* Strong knowledge and experience with HR Business Partner (generalist), Talent Acquisition/Planning, Learning and Development, Employee Relations, Organizational Development, Change Management, and Diversity \& Inclusion functions
* Broad business and financial understanding and the ability to apply to human capital implications
* Ability to think strategically, synthesize complex business/financial data and develop innovative and holistic HR solutions
* Resilience to work within a complex organization and find creative solutions
* Willingness to work and integrate with multiple partners and manage simultaneous priorities
* Strong executive consulting and client relationship skills
* Proven collaboration skills with the ability to gain consensus through personal influence
* Proven ability to manage conflict and the courage to challenge organizational thinking
* Demonstrated ability to invite diverse perspectives, and promote an inclusive work environment
* Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills
* Act as a role model for the organization and source of knowledge.


**Leadership Competencies**
* Ability to think strategically and translate concepts into actionable items.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with ability to present effectively to executive groups; all staff events; Town Halls etc.
* Ability to position self as credible, proactive, and trusted thought partner and coach with senior executives and stakeholders.
* Flexible working style, balancing the ability to collaborate across matrixed structures and work effectively in teams, whilst being a self\-starter, autonomous and able to self\-manage with minimal supervision.
* Ability to effectively lead teams and manage complex projects across multiple groups
* High work ethic, capacity to work under pressure and pace
* Embraces Disney Heritage and Values
* Equally adept at consulting, thinking strategically and executing day\-to\-day HR operations.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources/ Employment Relations, or related field (or equivalent experience gained within an international, matrixed organization).
* Master’s Degree in Human Resources/ Employment Relations (or related field), highly regarded


 The Walt Disney Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to be a diverse workforce that is representative of our audiences, and where all can thrive and belong. We are committed to building a team that includes and respects a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Power Bridge is a customer centric AV \& IT Infrastructure Solution \& Services Provider, pivoting to bridge the Gap between innovative IT products, solutions and Customer needs.
   

  

 With Offices in Bangalore (HQ) and Hyderabad, we boast the capabilities and operational excellence to execute projects for our customers across India.
   

  

 Our Passionate teams across business functions work in tandem with our Industry leading Technology partners to deliver hassle\-free technology upgrades projects with time bound SLA’s.
   

  

 We’re seeking an experienced Network \& Security Engineer with 4 years of experience to operate, optimize, and secure enterprise network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will own L2/L3 troubleshooting, implement security policies, and drive continuous improvement across Cisco switching/routing, SonicWall \& Fortinet firewalls, Cisco WLC/Wi‑Fi, and SSE solutions like Netskope.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Operations \& Support**
* Provide L2/L3 support for LAN/WAN, Wi‑Fi, and security incidents; drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
* Manage and optimize Cisco routers/switches (OSPF/EIGRP, STP, VLANs, HSRP/VRRP, QoS).
* Administer Cisco WLC and enterprise Wi‑Fi (AP provisioning, RF optimization, WPA2/3‑Enterprise, 802\.1X).


**Firewall \& Security**
* Configure and maintain SonicWall and Fortinet (FortiGate) firewalls (NAT, VPN, SD‑WAN, policies, IPS/AV/WEB).
* Implement site‑to‑site and remote‑access VPNs, certificate management, and high availability.
* Tune security profiles (IPS, Anti‑Virus, Web Filter, Application Control) and monitor threat activity.


**SSE / Cloud Security**
* Operate Netskope (SWG, CASB, ZTNA/DLP policies), integrate with IdP (Azure AD/Okta), and onboard endpoints.
* Analyze SSE logs/events; optimize policies for user experience and risk reduction.


**Monitoring \& Reliability**
* Maintain FortiAnalyzer, SonicWall Analytics.
* Define and track SLAs/OLAs; drive capacity planning and performance baselines.


**Change \& Compliance**
* Lead changes via ITIL processes (Request/Change/Problem); maintain network diagrams and SOPs.
* Ensure compliance with security standards (e.g., ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks) and audit readiness.


**Collaboration**
* Work with InfoSec, Workplace, Cloud, and App teams on new projects (M\&A, branch rollout, cloud migrations).
* Vendor coordination for complex issues, RMAs, and firmware advisories.


**Must‑Have Skills**
* Routing/Switching: VLAN, trunking, inter‑VLAN, STP/RSTP, NAT, QoS.
* Cisco WLC/Wi‑Fi: RF design basics, AP groups, FlexConnect/Local mode, RADIUS/802\.1X, Fast Secure Roaming.


**Firewalls**
* SonicWall: Access rules, NAT, DPI, VPN (IKEv2\), App Control, HA.
* Fortinet: Policy/Objects, SD‑WAN, IPSec/SSL‑VPN, UTM profiles, HA (A‑A/A‑P), FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer.
* Netskope: SWG, CASB, ZTNA, DLP, policy creation, client deployment, log analysis.
* Security Foundations: TCP/IP, TLS/PKI, DNS/DHCP, identity\-aware policies, segmentation (ACLs/VLANs).
* Scripting/Automation (nice\-to\-have): Python/PowerShell, REST APIs for device/report automation.
* Tooling: Wireshark, Nmap, SolarWinds/PRTG, FortiAnalyzer, SonicWall Analytics,


**Certifications (Preferred)**
* Cisco: CCNA (required or equivalent)
* Fortinet: NSE 4 (Firewall Professional) or higher (NSE 5/7 nice\-to\-have).

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

 System Engineer (Network Engineer)
   

  

 We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Network Engineer to manage, operate, and support our enterprise network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have deep hands\-on experience in firewalls, switching, wireless technologies, and network security, with strong expertise in troubleshooting, configuration, and operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, configure, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure including firewalls, switches, wireless, and cloud security platforms.
* Manage and troubleshoot Palo Alto Firewalls (mandatory) — policies, NAT, VPNs, security profiles, upgrades, and HA.
* Configure and support Cisco Nexus switches (mandatory) — VLANs, VPC, routing, OS upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Manage Cisco Meraki switches and access points (mandatory), including dashboard administration, monitoring, wireless optimization, fine\-tuning, and architecture understanding.
* Support Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and ZTNA solutions, including policy configuration and user troubleshooting.
* Monitor network performance using standard network monitoring tools, proactively identifying and troubleshooting issues.
* Handle incidents, service requests, and changes through a ticketing system, ensuring adherence to SLAs and ITIL processes.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for network issues and implement preventive actions.
* Work closely with internal teams, vendors, and service providers for issue resolution and continuous improvement.
* Participate in network upgrades, migrations, and new technology implementations.
* Maintain network documentation, SOPs, and diagrams.


**Mandatory Skills \& Qualifications**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Palo Alto Firewalls (mandatory).
* Extensive experience with Cisco Nexus switches (mandatory).
* Hands\-on experience with Cisco Meraki switches and wireless access points (mandatory).
* Experience with Zscaler (ZIA) and ZTNA security solutions.
* Solid understanding of network monitoring tools (mandatory).
* Experience working with IT ticketing systems and operational processes (mandatory).
* Deep technical expertise in Firewalls, Switching, and Wireless technologies, including configuration and advanced troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, routing, switching, and network security concepts.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Knowledge of Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX).
* Exposure to cloud networking (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Relevant certifications such as CCNP, PCNSE, Meraki, Security certifications, etc.


 Behavioral \& Soft Skills
   

  

* Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong ownership mindset with customer\-centric and operational focus.
* Strong documentation creation ability.


 Work Requirements
   

  

* 5 days work from office (no remote/hybrid).
* Availability for critical issue support, maintenance windows, and on\-call support as required


 Location \- Bangalore

title: Software Development Engineer, JWO
description:
**Description**
 As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
   

  

 The Team: From the merchandise stores at Sports venues to small\-format stores such as Amazon Go, a new kind of technology is powering stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use the Amazon app to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals, grocery essentials and merchandise, and go.
   

  

 Our checkout\-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out (JWO) Technology. It automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a cart. When you’re done shopping, you just leave the store. Shortly after, we’ll charge your Amazon account and send you a receipt. Designed and custom\-built by Amazonians, our technology uses computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA. We need people who want to join a high\-reaching program that continues to push the state of the art in computer vision, machine learning, distributed systems and hardware design.
   

  

 The Role: Everyone on our team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats and work in a highly collaborative environment that’s more startup than big company. We’re solving problems that span a broad range of domains: computer vision, image recognition, machine learning, and distributed systems. This role involves building/scaling Machine Learning platform used for developing all the algorithms at JWO.
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer, you will help solve a variety of technical challenges and mentor other engineers. You will play an active role in translating business and functional requirements into concrete deliverables and build quick prototypes or proofs of concept in partnership with other technology leaders within the team. You will help invent new features, design, develop and deploy reliable distributed services. You will work with a variety of core languages and technologies including Java, C\+\+, Linux.
   

  

 You will tackle challenging situations every day and you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that’s higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving problems. Along the way, we guarantee that you’ll learn a ton, have fun and make a positive impact on many customers.
   

  

 The Role: You are a talented Software Engineer who knows how to design and code full\-stack solutions. You know how to get things done, and done really well. You are a dreamer and a futurist. You have an inventor’s spirit, a can\-do approach and proficiency in a wide range of design technologies, and a killer eye for detail. We are looking for talented engineers for Java and AWS services.
   

  

 In this role you’ll have the opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a game\-changing initiative. While you’ll be able to use existing Amazon systems when possible, you’ll be working on challenging problems that need creative solutions. You should be comfortable building prototypes, challenging assumptions, and thinking of creative ways to tackle challenges.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications·**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* Programming experience with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* 1\+ years contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems


**Preferred Qualifications·**
* Engineering in Computer Science or related field
* Experience as a key member of a full\-stack engineering team participating in the complete product development life cycle of successfully launched applications.
* Experience with designing and building systems in a multi\-tiered, distributed environment (Service Oriented Architecture).
* Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and project planning/execution skills including estimating and scheduling.
* Experience optimizing for short\-term execution while planning for long\-term technical capabilities. Ability and willingness to multi\-task and learn new technologies quickly.


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

 • Demonstrable taste. We will look at what you have shipped and form a view on whether it is good. Polish, clarity, and visual hierarchy matter to us.
 



 • Real experience with data\-heavy or enterprise interfaces: dashboards, tables, time\-series charts, complex forms. 
 



 • Hands\-on experience with REST and WebSocket clients, error handling, retries, and optimistic updates.
 



 • Working knowledge of accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).
 



 • Comfort owning a feature end to end without hand\-holding, from the API contract to the production deploy.
 



 • Git discipline, code review habits, and an instinct for clean, testable code.
 



  





**What we are not asking you to already know** 




 We are not filtering on specific libraries or tools you can pick up on the job. If your fundamentals are strong you will be fine with our stack choices around build tooling, state management, component libraries, and styling. We care about the work you have actually shipped, not tag matching.
 



  





**Bonus points** 




 • Gantt charts, dependency graphs, or other complex schedule visualisations.
 



 • BIM or 3D web viewers (Autodesk Forge, Speckle, xeokit, three.js).
 



 • Data visualisation libraries (D3, Plotly, Recharts), especially for dashboards.
 



 • Map libraries (Mapbox, deck.gl, Leaflet) for site and GIS views.
 



 • Heavy daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, or other AI coding agents in your real workflow.
 



 Personality and mindset
 



 • Hustler. You move fast, you unblock yourself, and you do not wait for a perfect spec.
 



 • Hard worker with a builder mindset. You enjoy shipping, take pride in production code, and think in customer outcomes.
 



 • Hands on with deployment. You are comfortable owning a feature from design to production, including the ugly bits.
 



 • Growth mindset. You stay flexible, give and take feedback well, and keep getting better.
 



  





**What you will get** 




 • Real ownership of the entire frontend of a deeptech product used on live infrastructure programmes.
 



 • Direct exposure to founder, customers, and senior leaders from day one with a fair compensation taking into account growth and alignment
 



 • A genuinely AI\-first stack. We use Claude Code, Cursor, and Anthropic agents heavily, and you will too.
 



 • Steep learning curve across vertical AI, construction technology, and enterprise SaaS.
 



 • A small, senior team where your work is visible, your decisions matter, and your code reaches customers within days.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Frontend Developer Job Description
 
 We are hiring a frontend developer who can take ownership, move fast, and ship clean production\-ready work without constant supervision.
 



  





 This role is for someone who knows how to build with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, has experience working on both websites and web apps, and understands how to use modern agentic coding workflows properly. Speed matters, but not at the cost of quality. We are not looking for someone who depends on AI to do basic engineering work for them. We are looking for an actual engineer who can think, build, debug, communicate, and deliver.
 



  




 Role Overview
 
 You will be responsible for frontend development work end to end. This is not a support role where someone else carries the quality, thinking, or delivery. We expect the person in this role to take full ownership of assigned frontend work and deliver it in a state that is usable, stable, responsive, and ready for release.
 



  





 You should be able to turn designs into code exactly, handle edge cases, maintain code quality, and clearly communicate progress to both technical and non\-technical people.
 


 Core Requirements
 * Strong working experience with Next.js
* Strong working experience with Tailwind CSS
* Experience building both websites and web applications
* Must provide live links to hosted work as proof of ability
* Live production apps or websites with real users are strongly preferred over demo projects
* Must know how to use agentic coding workflows to build faster without compromising quality
* Must still be capable of engineering independently without relying on agents for everything
* Must write clean, maintainable, scalable code
* Must understand coding best practices and production discipline
* Must know how to use Git properly
* Must be able to replicate Figma designs exactly with pixel\-perfect accuracy
* Must be able to make designs responsive even if mobile designs are not provided
* Must have good design taste
* Must have reliable internet
* Must be comfortable communicating through Discord



  




 Engineering Standards
 
 The following are non\-negotiable:
 


* Messy, unscalable code is unacceptable
* Long files with code dumps are unacceptable
* Poor production practices are unacceptable
* Environment variables and production configuration must be handled properly
* Error states must be handled properly
* Work must be responsive and stable
* Work must follow design guidelines accurately
* Work cannot be submitted in an incomplete or fragile state
* If something breaks with a few clicks, it is not ready
* If something cannot reasonably be released to the public, it is not ready



  




 What We Care About Most1\. Deadlines cannot be missed
 
 We understand the speed at which frontend projects can move with modern agentic workflows. Deadlines will be reasonable and achievable. Once committed, they are expected to be met.
 



  





 Missed deadlines create backlogs and break operations. That is not acceptable.
 



  




 2\. Sloppy work is unacceptable
 
 Some work needs to be done fast. Some work needs to be done with extreme precision. Expectations will be informed clearly, but either way the work must be done properly.
 



  





 Do not submit work that is unfinished, unstable, not responsive, inconsistent with the design, or missing obvious edge cases and error handling.
 



  




 3\. Poor communication is a deal breaker
 
 You must be able to explain:
 


* what you are doing
* why you are doing it
* what the current status is
* what the next steps are



 You must be able to communicate clearly with non\-technical people as well. Timely updates matter. Vague communication, disappearing, or being unable to explain your own work is not acceptable.
 



  




 4\. Constant handholding is not acceptable
 
 We will help with training, support, roadblocks, and gaps in knowledge where needed. That is normal.
 



 What is not acceptable is being unable to problem solve, think independently, or build and deliver assigned work end to end. Frontend work assigned to you is your responsibility. We are looking for someone who can own this part of the development process properly.
 



  




 5\. You must be able to adapt quickly
 
 Frameworks, systems, workflows, and responsibilities can change. We need someone who is open to learning quickly and adapting fast when needed.
 



  





 If you are rigid, slow to adapt, or resistant to learning new things, this role is probably not for you.
 



  




 Hiring Criteria
 
 You have a high chance of being selected if:
 


* you can show real products with real users
* your frontend design and development quality is clearly strong
* your implementation is polished and accurate
* your communication is solid
* your English speaking and writing skills are good



 Freshers can still apply. We may also recruit for internships or consider candidates for other roles if the fit is strong.
 



  




 Nice to Haves
 
 These are not required, but they are a plus:
 


* Marketing background or a practical understanding of marketing concepts
* Understands conversion\-focused design and how design decisions affect user behavior



  




 Work SetupFull\-time
 * 8 hours a day
* 6 days a week
* Sunday off
* Fully remote
* Work hours start from 12:00 PM



  




 Project\-based
 * Compensation and working hours are flexible and negotiable
* In both cases, what matters is that the work gets done properly and before deadlines



  




 Communication
 * Primary communication will happen through Discord
* You must be available for timely communication and updates during working hours
* You must have stable and reliable internet



  




 CompensationProject\-based
 
 Negotiable based on demonstrated skill, quality of work, speed of delivery, and how much handholding is required.
 



  




 Semi\-qualified full\-time
 
 Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 30,000 per month
 



  




 Fully qualified full\-time
 
 Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month
 



  




 Maximum compensation for this role
 
 Up to Rs. 1\.2 lakh per month depending on fit, capability, and ownership
 



  




 Internship
 
 Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 7,000 per month based on skill
 



  




 Hiring Process
 * Send your application
* If shortlisted, you will be required to fill out a qualification questions document
* If selected after that, we will set up an interview call
* Beyond that, there will be either a 1 month project\-based evaluation period or compensation equivalent to 50% of the base compensation to confirm fit. If unfit, we will discontinue.
* Hiring will be confirmed after successful completion of that evaluation stage



  




 Application Instructions
 
 Please send:
 


* your resume
* your portfolio, if available
* live links to hosted websites or web apps you have built
* a short note explaining what exactly you worked on in each project
* your GitHub profile, if available



 If you have real production work, show it. If your frontend eye is strong, make it obvious. If you can build fast and clean, that will stand out.
 



  




 Application Questions
 
 Applicants should answer the following in their application:
 


* What is your current development process to go from design to final polished output?
* If a design is provided containing 1 homepage and 3 additional pages, how much time would you need to provide the final polished output? (Final polished output means work that is complete, responsive, consistent, and ready for release. Untested code, designs breaking across screen sizes, inconsistent design, or copy not matching with what was provided will not be considered final output.)
* What makes you stand out from other people applying for this role?



  




 Important Application Note
 
 All content submitted in your application or proposal will be passed through AI detection and plagiarism checking tools.
 


* AI\-written applications will be rejected immediately
* Applicants must write everything themselves
* This is part of our communication skills and quality check



  




 Final Note
 
 This role is for someone who can take responsibility, deliver on time, communicate clearly, and maintain a high quality bar consistently.
 


* If you need constant supervision, miss deadlines, submit careless work, or cannot own frontend delivery properly, this role will not be a fit.

description:
**About Arthace** Arthace ("Maximise Financial Intelligence") is an AI\-powered double\-entry accounting product for Indian businesses. We're at pilot stage and shipping toward a public launch in couple of months. We're hiring our first engineer to take over day\-to\-day engineering execution and ship the launch alongside the founder.

**Role at a glance**

* Position: Junior Full\-Stack Developer (first technical hire)
* Experience: 1–3 years (strong freshers with shipped projects also welcome)
* Salary: ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month (top of band for clear AI\-tool shipping history)
* Hours: Mon–Sat, standard business hours, onsite
* Reporting: Directly to founders
* **Immediate joiners strongly preferred**

**Where you'll work**

* **First month:** at our office in Tatithaiya (Block 178, Parekh Industrial Estate, Tal\-Palsana, Surat 394315\), working closely with the engineering founder
* **From month 2 onward:** at our coworking space in **Vesu, Surat** with the rest of the team

This is an onsite role.

**What you'll own**

*Bug fixing in the live product*

* Take partner\-reported bugs across voucher pages, reports, and master data screens; locate the surface in our React \+ Node \+ Postgres codebase; ship a clean fix using AI coding tools
* Read AI\-generated code critically \- catch issues, push back when something is wrong, validate the output before it ships
* For accounting\-sensitive changes, run the audit checks before pushing \- incorrect numbers are unacceptable

*Deploys and CI*

* Own the deploy pipeline on Railway: every push triggers a deploy, you confirm the healthcheck goes green and surface failed builds with the failing log step
* Own GitHub Actions CI hygiene: when tests go red, you triage whether it's a real regression or an environment issue, and resolve it the same day
* Manage environment variables and connection strings carefully \- no credentials in chat, ever

*Data safety*

* Own daily Postgres backups, restore tests, and off\-site copies. Client financial data must never be lost
* Maintain SSL, secrets management, access control, and a sensible security posture we can show clients

*Release handoffs to QA*

* After every shipped change, author a clear "for smoke test" handoff document
* Co\-founder Rahul runs partner\-pilot QA on every release before it goes live; you collate his retest feedback at the start of the next session and flag what passed vs. what still needs work

*Pilot growth*

* Help onboard new pilot accountants: run our import scripts, verify the trial balance matches their existing system
* As you ramp, take ownership of one larger feature track post\-launch (bank reconciliation / GSTR\-2A / multi\-tenant scale\-up)

**Must\-have skills**

* Hands\-on experience using **AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) to actually build and ship a project** \- please share what you built
* Working knowledge of **Node.js or Python** \- comfortable reading and writing backend code
* Comfort with **Git, command line, and reading logs** (build logs, server logs, browser console errors)
* Experience **deploying an application to a real server** (Railway, Vercel, AWS, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, or similar) \- env vars, healthchecks, connection strings
* Basic **SQL** — SELECT / JOIN / WHERE / GROUP BY, transactions, indexes
* Strong written and spoken English \- you'll write daily release handoffs another person executes without re\-asking
* Honesty about what you do and don't know

**Nice to have**

* PostgreSQL or Prisma ORM beyond basic queries
