title: People Business Partner
description:
The purpose of the role is to support a visible and highly proactive local HR service in India to management and staff with advice, information and practical guidance on a range of generalist HR issues including employee relations and employment legislation, recruitment and selection, policy related matters, absence management, pay and benefits and contractual issues.

**Key Responsibilities**


Strategic Commercial Business Partner  

* Partnering with stakeholders to ensure a fantastic team environment and managing any HR questions or Employee Relations cases which might arise.
* Partner with business heads on strategic initiatives to support growth and business transformation.
* Provide managers with a commercial understanding of their people agenda and proactively ensure the HR function is facilitating the business in delivering their strategy and objectives.
* Drive projects around talent planning, learning \& development, and employee engagement in partnership with the Global HR team.

HR Management  

* Working with the wider HR COE teams to provide a seamless HR service and to leverage from other’s experience/knowledge.
* Manage Employee Relations issues including disciplinary, grievance, performance, and redundancy processes, providing advice and guidance to the business on all employee related matters ensuring best practice and legal compliance.
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date knowledge and awareness of new and existing employment legislation in India.
* Work closely with local labor authorities to establish and implement a sound talent acquisition strategy and action plan.
* Coordinate all Audit \& Due Diligence activity in the local HR department \& provide solutions for any issues or failings in HR processes.
* Mobility \- support Hiring and Project Managers, and employees with the relocation of new employees or current employees for projects.
* Health and Safety \- Provide support and education to Managers and staff towards a healthy and safe work environment.
* Ensure that payroll processes are completed accurately and effectively executed each month.
* Ensure that all local policies are up to date and comply with both internal and external guidelines/laws.
* Support optimization, deployment, and adoption of Workday HRIS.
* In addition to India, to have capacity to support the wider APAC HR team as needed.
* Any other projects and assignments assigned and delegated from your manager from time to time.
**Performance Assessment**  

Competencies identified to perform the role effectively include (but not exclusive to):  

* Accuracy/Attention to detail – Complete tasks accurately, completely and to agreed deadlines/ targets (KPI’s) according to the standards and procedures outlined.
* Time Management – Prioritising work to ensure that outputs meet required standards and the needs of both internal and external clients.
* Communication Skills – Communicate effectively with internal FNZ staff and external agents to ensure people related issues are resolved as quickly as possible.
* Strong people and stakeholder management skills – able to establish relationships with leadership team, employees and other third parties to provide operational efficiencies and resolution.
* Problem Solving/Initiative – Using your skills and knowledge to ensure correct end results are achieved for our employees in a timely manner.
* People focus – Be aware and continually thinking about those whom your role impacts on and aiming to deliver a consistently high service.
* Ownership and Responsibility \- Demonstrates personal accountability by flagging errors to Manager and taking requisite corrective action promptly. Escalates issues promptly and responds positively to feedback.
* Teamwork – During downtime or quiet periods look to see where assistance can be given to other members of the team to ensure the whole team achieves their goals.
* As in any service function, we experience busier periods i.e. month end, payroll cut\-off date and statutory social benefits time frame, etc. which may require HR to pull together and potentially work flexibly as required. Hence the ability to work well in a team environment and drive and desire to meet deadlines is essential in this role.
**Experience required**  

* HR executive who has around 3 to 6 years of experience.
* Experience working through ambiguity, willing to roll up their sleeves to get the job done.
* Experience working in a generalist role within a fast\-paced environment, with a strong commercial entrepreneurial spirit.
* The desire to be a significant contributor to the business in a fun, dynamic and fast\-paced environment.
* Exposure to running the design, implementation and reporting of employee engagement and culture projects.
* Strong facilitation and consultancy skills; able to consult on a range of relatively complex people issues with a proven ability to deliver against a range of conflicting demands.
* Able to quickly establish credibility and maintains positive \& productive working relationships with colleagues
* Organised and proactive, with the drive to deliver results and manage self effectively.
* High impact as a communicator \- verbally, written and in meetings.
* Personal drive and commitment to delivery of results, through others where necessary.
* Capable of working to deadlines and adapting to changing conditions, ability to generate effective and pragmatic solutions to new situations and problems as they are presented.
* Effectively plan ahead, making sensible balanced decisions in a deadline driven environment.
* Strong working knowledge of employment law issues and the ability to apply these to a variety of situations using a pragmatic and common\-sense approach.
* Global/multinational work experience as typically someone can navigate complex, matrixed organisations.
*About FNZ*

 •     Proven ability to build HR systems and policies from scratch

**WHY JOIN CITYFURNISH**

**Location :** Pune (Pimpri\- Chinchwad )

* Act as the primary point of contact for all site labour issues

* Handle day\-to\-day labour concerns, disputes, and grievances
* Ensure smooth coordination between site supervisors and labour teams

**2\. Contractor \& Labour Sourcing**

* Identify and onboard reliable labour contractors
* Arrange skilled and unskilled workers as per project requirements
* Maintain a database of contractors and labour availability
* Ensure timely mobilization of manpower for new and ongoing sites

* Plan manpower deployment across multiple sites
* Arrange **relievers/substitutes** for site supervisors and key workers
* Ensure no work disruption due to absenteeism or attrition

* Ensure compliance with labour laws and site regulations
* Maintain records:
* Attendance
* Wage registers
* Contractor agreements
* Coordinate for PF, ESIC (if applicable through contractors)
* Ensure safety norms are followed at site

**5\. Coordination with Management**

* Provide daily/weekly updates on manpower status
* Highlight risks:
* Labour shortages
* Disputes
* Delays due to manpower issues
* Support project managers in manpower budgeting

**Experience**

* **5–10 years experience** in:
* Factory HR / Labour Officer role
* Construction / infrastructure sites
* Manufacturing units with contract labour
* Experience handling **blue\-collar workforce at scale** is essential

**Skills Required**

* Strong **people handling** and negotiation skills
* Ability to manage **unstructured labour environments**
* Practical knowledge of:
* Labour laws
* Contractor management
* Problem\-solving attitude with field orientation
* Ability to work under pressure and travel frequently

**Preferred Background**

* Experience in:
* Construction companies
* Waterproofing / civil contracting
* Manufacturing plants with contract labour

* No site shutdown due to labour shortage
* Timely availability of manpower across projects
* Reduction in labour disputes/issues
* Efficient reliever planning for supervisors
* Compliance with labour regulations

title: Associate Financial Analyst
description:
**Financial Analyst**

**This Position**  combines deep expertise in financial statement analysis and Excel\-based modelling with the ability to communicate complex insights clearly — both in written reports and live presentations. You will play a critical role in guiding data\-driven decisions across business units and senior leadership.

**Key Responsibilities** 

* Analyse financial statements — income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements — for business units, clients, and investment opportunities.
* Perform ratio analysis (liquidity, profitability, leverage, efficiency) to evaluate financial health and performance trends.
* Build, maintain, and enhance dynamic financial models and dashboards in Excel for forecasting, variance analysis, and scenario planning.
* Prepare polished, professional presentations (PowerPoint/slides) to communicate findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Prepare clear, concise written reports summarising financial insights, risks, and strategic recommendations.
* Support budgeting, planning, and month\-end/quarter\-end close processes with accurate financial data.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (operations, risk, legal, sales) to provide financial insights that inform decisions.
* Monitor KPIs and flag variances or anomalies for management review.
* Ensure all financial analysis and documentation comply with company policies and applicable regulatory standards.
* Stay informed on market developments, industry benchmarks, and macroeconomic trends relevant to the business.

**Financial Analysis \& Modelling**

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel — data entry, basic formulas (SUM, AVERAGE, IF), and simple charts for reporting purposes.
* Ability to organise and maintain financial data in structured spreadsheets for day\-to\-day analysis tasks.
* Financial statement analysis — reading and interpreting income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
* Comprehensive ratio analysis — liquidity (current, quick), profitability (ROE, ROA, EBITDA margins), solvency (D/E, interest coverage), and efficiency (asset turnover, receivables days).
* Cash flow analysis — operating vs. investing vs. financing activities; free cash flow computation and interpretation.

Soft Skills:

* Exceptional written communication — ability to draft clear, structured financial reports and executive summaries.
* Strong verbal communication — comfortable presenting analysis and recommendations to senior management and non\-finance stakeholders.
* Advanced presentation skills — translates complex data into compelling visual narratives, experience with slide storytelling.
* Active listening and stakeholder management — understands business context and tailors’ communication accordingly.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under deadlines.
* Collaborative mindset with a proactive, solution\-oriented attitude.

**Tools \& Standards**

* Strong working knowledge of GAAP or IFRS accounting standards.
* Experience with financial reporting tools, ERP systems, or BI platforms is an advantage.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint or equivalent for creating high\-impact presentation decks.
* Familiarity with credit bureaus (CIBIL, Equifax, Experian) and CRM platforms is a plus.

**Education and Skills** 

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (MBA or CA/CFA preferred or in progress).
* 1–3 years of experience in financial analysis, investment analysis, corporate finance, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience building Excel\-based financial models and presenting to stakeholders.
* Freshers with exceptional academic profiles and strong project/internship portfolios are encouraged to apply.

title: Polymer Laboratory Technician
description:
Working at **Ray Colors**, a specialized masterbatch manufacturer based in Anand, Gujarat, involves working with high\-tech equipment to develop and test colorants and performance additives. Since they cater to demanding sectors like fiber, automotive, and packaging, the role of a Lab Technician is critical for maintaining their reputation for "innovation and honesty."

Below is a structured job description tailored for both entry\-level and experienced candidates.

Job Title: Polymer Lab Technician

**Location:** Anand (Vitthal Udyognagar), Gujarat

**Company:** Ray Colors (Masterbatch \& Compound Division)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Role Overview

You will be responsible for the formulation, testing, and quality assurance of polymer masterbatches. This includes color matching, physical property testing, and operating lab\-scale machinery to ensure products meet stringent industrial standards (ISO/ASTM).

Key ResponsibilitiesFor Freshers (Trainee Level)

* **Sample Preparation:** Assist in weighing pigments, additives, and resins according to batch cards.
* **Machine Operation:** Learn to operate lab\-scale extruders, injection molding machines, and blown\-film lines under supervision.
* **Testing Basics:** Perform routine tests such as **Melt Flow Index (MFI)** and moisture analysis.
* **Housekeeping:** Maintain a clean and organized laboratory environment and ensure all samples are labeled and stored correctly.
* **Documentation:** Accurately record test data in lab registers or ERP systems.

For Experienced Candidates (Senior/Technician Level)

* **Color Matching:** Use spectrophotometers to match precise shades and develop new color formulations (Black, White, and Special Effects).
* **Advanced Testing:** Conduct complex analyses including **Filter Pressure Tests (FPT)**, Tensile Strength, and UV Weathering tests.
* **R\&D Support:** Collaborate with the R\&D team to develop "Nano Masterbatches" or high\-performance additives.
* **Troubleshooting:** Identify the root cause of batch failures (e.g., poor dispersion or pigment streaks) and suggest corrective actions.
* **Calibration:** Manage the periodic calibration and maintenance of sensitive lab instruments.

Technical Skills \& Qualifications

* **Education:** B.Sc./M.Sc. in Chemistry, Diploma/B.E. in Polymer Technology, or a PGD\-PPT from **CIPET**.
* **Knowledge:** Understanding of carrier polymers (PE, PP, PET, ABS, etc.) and the chemistry of pigments/additives.
* **Standards:** Familiarity with ASTM/ISO testing standards for plastics.
* **Software:** Basic proficiency in MS Office (Excel) for data reporting.

Required Competencies

* **Attention to Detail:** Critical for accurate color matching where even a $0\.1\\%$ variance matters.
* **Safety Mindset:** Strict adherence to PPE protocols (gloves, masks, goggles) when handling chemicals and hot machinery.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Ability to interpret data and translate it into process improvements.

description:
**About Om Electricals Power Pvt. Ltd.**

Since 1978, OEPL has set the benchmark for HT \& LT motor, transformer, and electromagnet rewind, repair, and reconditioning across eastern India. Our world\-class workshop infrastructure and four decades of expertise empower us to deliver precision, reliability, and safety on every project.

**Role Overview**

We’re seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented **Accountant** to manage the financial health and daily accounting operations of our company. You will drive financial reporting, tax compliance, cost accounting, and cash flow management to ensure the fiscal efficiency and profitability of our heavy\-engineering and workshop services.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Financial Accounting \& Bookkeeping**
* Maintain precise daily records of all financial transactions using accounting software.
* Manage Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR), ensuring timely payments to raw material vendors (e.g., copper, insulation suppliers) and prompt invoicing for completed workshop projects.
* **Cost Accounting \& Inventory Management**
* Implement and oversee job\-costing methods to track the exact costs associated with individual motor rewind and transformer overhaul projects.
* Monitor and reconcile inventory valuations for raw materials, workshop tools, and work\-in\-progress to optimize budget utilization.
* **Taxation \& Statutory Compliance**
* Calculate, prepare, and file monthly/quarterly statutory returns, including GST, TDS, PF, and ESI.
* Ensure strict adherence to Indian Accounting Standards and local financial regulations.
* **Reporting \& Reconciliation**
* Perform regular bank, vendor, and ledger reconciliations.
* Prepare comprehensive financial statements (Profit \& Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and monthly MIS reports for senior management to track workshop profitability.
* **Audit \& Financial Planning**
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors, ensuring all financial documentation and ledgers are accurate and readily available.
* Assist management in preparing annual budgets, forecasting financial needs, and implementing cost\-control measures across workshop operations.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Commerce (B.Com/M.Com) or Finance. Candidates with CA Inter or CMA (ICWA) Inter qualifications are highly preferred.
* **Experience:**
* 4–7 years of proven accounting experience.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
* Expertise in **Tally Prime**.
* Deep understanding of current GST structures, TDS, and corporate taxation rules.
* Familiarity with ERP systems is a strong advantage.
* **Leadership \& Soft Skills:**
* Meticulous attention to detail, high integrity, and strong analytical problem\-solving abilities.

title: Embedded Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Summary:**

Muonix, a rapidly expanding electronics manufacturing company based in Jaipur, is looking for a highly skilled **Embedded Systems Engineer** to design, develop, and implement firmware for our next generation of hardware products. You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of microcontroller programming—from selecting the right architecture to writing low\-level drivers and optimizing system performance. The ideal candidates will possess a strong passion for electronics and a desire to contribute to the manufacturing of high\-quality electronic products.

**Responsibilities:**

* Microcontroller Programming: Design and implement firmware in C/C\+\+ for various MCU architectures (e.g., ARM Cortex\-M, ESP32, STM32, or PIC).
* Hardware Interfacing: Develop and debug low\-level drivers for peripherals such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, ADC, and PWM.
* System Architecture: Design efficient software architectures for real\-time systems, including memory management and power optimization.
* Testing \& Debugging: Use hardware tools like Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers, and Multimeters to troubleshoot firmware\-to\-hardware communication issues.
* RTOS Implementation: Develop applications using Real\-Time Operating Systems (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) or bare\-metal environments.
* Collaboration: Work closely with hardware engineers to review PCB schematics and ensure firmware compatibility with hardware layouts.

**Qualifications:**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* B. Tech. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science (IOT), or a related field.
* Prior experience in electronics manufacturing.
* Knowledge of industry standards and regulations.
* Familiarity with quality management systems.

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher, Internship

Pay: From ₹15,000\.00 per month

title: HR Interns
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive HR Intern with a strong interest in Indian Labour Law and Compliance Implementation. In this role, you will help bridge the gap between statutory requirements and daily HR operations. You will support the HR department in auditing existing practices, drafting compliant policies, and ensuring our organization adheres to the latest Central and State\-specific labor regulations in India.
   

  

 This is an ideal opportunity for a student or recent graduate pursuing an MBA in HR, a Master’s in Labour Studies (MLS), or a Bachelor of Laws (LLB) to gain hands\-on experience in a corporate compliance environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Statutory Research \& Monitoring


 Conduct research on the four new Labour Codes (Wage, Social Security, Industrial Relations, and Occupational Safety) and their phased implementation.
   

  

 Track updates regarding state\-specific Shops and Establishments Acts and Professional Tax requirements.
   

  

 Assist in mapping Central and State\-specific compliance requirements to internal HR processes.
   

  

* Policy Drafting \& Indian Compliance


 Assist in updating the Employee Handbook to ensure compliance with the Standing Orders Act and local leave policies.
   

  

 Support the POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Committee with administrative tasks, awareness posters, and documentation of training sessions.
   

  

 Draft Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for grievance redressal as per the Industrial Disputes Act.
   

  

* Compliance Auditing \& Payroll Support


 Perform audits of employee files to ensure mandatory documentation (Aadhaar, UAN, PAN, nomination forms) is complete.
   

  

 Review job descriptions to ensure alignment with Code on Wages definitions (e.g., distinguishing between 'Worker' and 'Employee' categories).
   

  

 Assist with "Statutory Health Checks" including EPF, ESI, and Gratuity record\-keeping.
   

  

* Training \& Education


 Help design internal training materials for managers on the POSH Act and the Maternity Benefit Act.
   

  

 Prepare FAQs on Indian tax deductions (TDS) and social security benefits to help employees understand their pay slips.
   

  

* Employee Relations \& Onboarding


 Support the HR team in drafting offer letters and employment contracts that comply with the latest Indian judicial precedents.
   

  

 Ensure all exit formalities align with statutory requirements for full and final (F\&F) settlements.
   

  

**Requirements \& Qualifications**
 Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA (HR), Master of Labour Studies (MLS), or LLB.
   

  

 Legal Literacy: Foundational knowledge of Indian Labour Laws (e.g., Factories Act, EPF Act, ESI Act, POSH Act, and Payment of Bonus Act).
   

  

 Attention to Detail: High level of precision in reviewing statutory registers and employee records.
   

  

 Confidentiality: Absolute discretion in handling sensitive employee data and PII (Personally Identifiable Information).
   

  

 Communication: Strong writing skills in English; proficiency in Hindi or other regional languages is an added advantage for interpreting local state rules.
   

  

 Learning Objectives
   

  

 By the end of this internship, the candidate will have:
   

  

 Developed a practical understanding of how Indian Labour Laws translate into corporate policy.
   

  

 Gained experience in risk mitigation, statutory filing processes, and HR auditing.
   

  

 Built a portfolio of drafted policies and compliance communication materials.
   

  

 Learned the complexities of managing compliance across different Indian states.

title: Cluster Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
With thousands of hotels in over 100 countries and territories, Hilton offers countless opportunities to delight. From an open door to a welcoming smile and an exceptional experience, we offer the millions of travellers who stay with us every year a welcome they will never forget. In addition to our flagship brand, Hilton Hotels \& Resorts, the family of brands includes Waldorf Astoria, LXR, Conrad, Canopy, Curio Collection, DoubleTree, Hilton Garden Inn, Hampton and many others.
   

  

 If you appreciate the impact global travel can have on the world, you may be just the person we are looking for to work as a Hilton Team Member. Because it’s with Hilton where we never forget the reason we're here: to delight our guests, Team Members, and owners alike.
   

  

**The Cluster Talent Acquisition Manager is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end recruitment function for five hotels i.e., Hilton and Hilton Garden Inn Bengaluru Embassy Manyata Business Park, Hilton Bangalore Embassy Golf Links, Hilton and Hilton Garden Inn Bangalore Embassy Tech Village, aligning recruitment activities with business goals, and ensuring a consistent, high\-quality talent pipeline. This role requires strong strategic planning, operational excellence, and a passion for building Hilton’s reputation as an employer of choice.**
**What will I be doing?**
 As the Cluster Talent Acquisition Manager, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:
   

  

* Responsible for managing the entire recruitment process (end\-to\-end) for all five hotels in the cluster.
* Report directly to the Cluster Director of Human Resources (Cluster DHR).
* Assist with the annual hotel manning budget by participating in headcount planning discussions with department heads.
* Develop and implement the annual cluster recruitment strategy to ensure timely hiring of qualified candidates.
* Maintain and expand effective recruitment channels and execute strategic recruitment activities.
* Ensure all open positions are posted on relevant recruitment platforms with brand\-compliant job advertisements.
* Source candidates, conduct first\-round interviews for all positions below Director level, and coordinate with hiring managers for subsequent interviews.
* Participate in campus hiring drives, job fairs, and recruitment campaigns across schools, colleges, and universities.
* Establish and maintain a systematic database of candidate profiles and recruitment activities.
* Monitor recruitment effectiveness and market trends, providing insights and strategy updates to HR leadership.
* Ensure timely candidate communication, feedback, onboarding, and smooth check\-in processes.
* Maintain professionalism and protect the Hilton employer brand across all recruitment touchpoints.
* Manage agency partnerships, internship programs, and monitor performance and agreements during contract periods.
* Conduct intern engagement activities to support intern conversion efforts.
* Maintain accuracy of recruitment and HR\-related systems, and provide relevant training.
* Conduct orientation and training sessions on recruitment systems and interview best practices for hiring managers.
* Support other HR initiatives such as employee data management, visa applications, team events, and facility oversight.
* Deliver accurate and timely recruitment reports to support HR analytics and business insights.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members, ensuring adherence to recruitment protocols and conducting performance reviews.
* Create and update recruitment content for internal and external media platforms.
* Perform any other duties as assigned by management.
* The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.


**What are we looking for?**
 A Cluster Talent Acquisition Manager serving Hilton is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:
   

  

* Minimum of 8–10 years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably within large\-scale 5\-star hotel environments.
* Proven track record of managing end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple properties.
* Strong experience with recruitment platforms like Taleo, Darwin Box, campus hiring, and talent marketing.
* Pre\-opening experience is an added advantage.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
* Proficient in HR systems and recruitment reporting tools.
* Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* A passion for people, hospitality, and driving Hilton's employer brand in the market.


**What will it be like to work for Hilton?**
 Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full\-service hotels and resorts to extended\-stay suites and mid\-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!
   

  

**Work Locations**
 Hilton Garden Inn Bengaluru Embassy Tech Village
   

  

**Schedule**
 Full\-time

**About The Health Insurance Industry –**
 While the current market sees more than 15 non\-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalised service provider (6\) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start\-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
   

  

 Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio\-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as intentions of health advisers. In this scenario it becomes extremely important to understand their psyche and then provide tailored solutions with wellness benefits which would help them meet their end objectives and bring in profitable revenue source for the company.
   

  

**About The Aditya Birla Health Insurance –**
 Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHICL) was incorporated in 2015 as a 51:49 joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) and MMI Strategic Investments (Pty) Ltd. ABHICL commenced its operations in October 2016\.
   

  

 ABHICL has entered the competitive health insurance market with an aim to expand the category to wider customer segments, beyond the ones that health insurance companies traditionally have marketed to. As the 6 th entrant in a category with well\-established players, ABHICL is creating differentiation and equity for itself though the unique business proposition of “Health Insurance for All”, a one of a kind proposition in India at the moment. This is a philosophy that is being built through every single consumer touch point and into every single backend process of the company to ensure a customer’s experience of our proposition is continuous and seamless.
   

  

 ABHI’s unique offering to market includes proposition includes \-
   

  

* A Comprehensive Incentivized Wellness Program that will attract the young and health conscious and will motivate, guide and reward them to stay healthy
* A Chronic Care Management Program to cater to the unmet needs of a growing Indian population of those suffering from chronic lifestyle conditions like Diabetes, Asthma, High Cholesterol and Hypertension from Day 1
* ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act like a much needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer relevant products.
* ABHICL’s vision has always been digital. The company has been successful in adopting paper\-less approach right from identifying to on\-boarding to delivering seamless experience of its customers \& employees.


**Challenges –**
* Though there is a strong association in employees – most of them have running policies from other companies and do not want to port immediately
* The road to customers is often through significant seniors in ABG, who need to understand inherent value proposition before granting access to other employees of organisation
* Since the customers are group employees and their references – any lacunae in service leads to immediate escalations.
* Soft Insurance Market: Considering the soft insurance market in India, offering new\-age solutions to price sensitive clients is difficult. It is extremely important to design and customize the right solution for the right set of clients.
* Upskill the recruited workforce and enable them to do concept selling as against hitherto habit of price based selling.
* Initiatives launched across companies need approvals from Heads in other companies – it is often difficult to secure their time to explain the product offerings and take their approvals to conduct activities.
* The customers often expect customised offerings. Offering and structuring a deal often involves working with various departments like operations, claims, actuarial etc to see what best can be offered. There may be instances that actuarial may not be comfortable offering a particular price that has been made available to the customer and hence working with them to see how best can things be modulated is often a tough ask. Also getting various stakeholders and constituents to the process like operations to understand the sensitivities of the various partners involved and seeing the creation of a process which meets our objective without offending either the partner concerned or the internal norms gets to be a challenge that has to be fought on a daily basis.

title: Hiring, People & Culture Executive
description:
**About Olio** 




 Olio Global AdTech LLP is
 **a growth marketing and technology transformation agency** 
 having its offices in Mumbai \& Pune. We're a 25\-person team across Strategy, Technology, SEO, Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, UI UX.
 



  





**This is a foundational hire.** 
 You'll be Olio's dedicated hiring, people operations \& culture leader, reporting directly to the Founders, with a meaningful seat in shaping how Olio scales over the next 18\-24 months. 
 



  





**Why This Role Is Different** 




 Most HR roles are either pure recruitment or pure operations — But here you'll wear three hats and become Olio's HRM operational backbone.
 



  





**Pillar 1 — Talent Acquisition (35%):** 




 Own the full hiring lifecycle for 15\-20 hires across the year. JD creation, sourcing, screening, scheduling, offer rollout, joining. You'll close most junior/mid hires yourself; partner with founders on senior hires.
 



  





**Pillar 2 — People Operations \& Employer Branding (40%):** 




 Own onboarding, employee handbook, POSH compliance, performance reviews, engagement, exits — and equally important, build Olio's employer brand. We want innovative ideas and execution that make Olio one of the most desirable agencies to work at in India.
 



  





**Pillar 3 — Operations \& Founder's Office (25%):** 




 Run office administration across both Mumbai HQ and Pune Baner, coordinate founder calendars and travel, manage vendors and finance liaison with accounts, own internal programs (Training, L\&D), drive internal communications, and become the operational glue between the core team and the rest of the team.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




**Experience:** 
 0\-3 years in HR, Talent Acquisition, or HR \+ Admin/Operations roles. Currently at HR Executive / Sr. HR Executive / TA Specialist / HR \& Admin Manager level.
 



  





**Background (Preference):** 
 You've worked in\-house at a marketing, advertising, digital, or creative agency. Bonus if you've already worn both HR and Operations hats.
 



  





**Track record (Preference):** 
 You've personally closed 10\+ hires, you've been involved in onboarding/ policies/ engagement, and ideally you've also driven employer branding initiatives or owned operational/admin work.
 



  





**Mindset:** 
 You're hungry. You want to own something, not coordinate someone else's work. You're a builder, not a maintainer. You enjoy variety — moving between hiring, trainings, founder meetings, and creative employer\-brand campaigns, vendor calls in a single day energizes you.
 



  





**Creative\-marketing instinct (key for employer branding):** 
 You think like a marketer when it comes to employer brand. You know what makes content stand out on LinkedIn \& respective digital platforms. You're not afraid to pitch unconventional ideas.
 



  





**Tech \& AI fluency:** 
 You actively use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) for JDs, screening, outreach, content drafts, and operational efficiency. You're comfortable with modern hiring stacks.
 



  





**Operational instinct:** 
 You think in systems and spot inefficiencies early. You create structure, improve team alignment, and build scalable hiring and culture processes that drive clarity and execution.
 



  





**Communication:** 
 Sharp written and verbal communication with the ability to confidently manage conversations across all levels.
 



  





**Why You'll Want This Role** 



* **Founder\-level visibility from Day 1** 
 — you report directly to the founders, no layers.
* **Build the People \& Operations function from scratch** 
 — every system, policy, and program.
* **Own employer branding as a real growth area, not an afterthought** 
 — bring your most creative ideas and ship them.
* **Real ownership across hiring, people, employer brand, and operations** 
 — four career tracks compounding in one seat.
* **AI\-first agency culture** 
 — you'll work with modern tools and modern thinking, not legacy processes.
* **Clear growth path** 
 — Talent Acquisition \& Culture Lead within 18\-24 months on strong performance.
* **Genuinely flexible** 
 — hybrid, not daily office. Travel only when needed (To Ghatkopar, Mumbai HQ \& Baner Pune.)



  





***Compensation: ₹3\-5 LPA \+ performance variable, with room to stretch for exceptional candidates***




  





**Apply If** 




 You've worked at an agency, you're hungry to own something bigger than your current role, you've got creative employer\-branding ideas you want to ship, and you want to build the People and Operations backbone at a scale\-up that's serious about doing this right. We'd love to hear from you.

**Company Description**
 "Why work for Accor?
   

  

 We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.
   

  

 By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/

**Job Description**
**Summary of Responsibilities:** 
 Reporting to the General Manager \& Regional People \& Culture Head, responsibilities and essential job functions include but are not limited to the following:
   

  

* Lead end‑to‑end recruitment and hiring processes, including job postings, applicant tracking (HERO), candidate follow‑up, job offers, background checks, compliance, and onboarding administration.

* Design, and/or roll out, and facilitate leadership development, diversity \& inclusion, discrimination \& harassment, and compliance training programs.

title: Senior HR Manager
description:
At Onemagnify India Global Delivery Centre we are looking for a Strategic Talent Architect of our human capital. We are the team that helps our great people achieve their dreams and live a life they love. We attract great talent, ensure our processes and policies embody our core values, and we provide support in developing and managing our greatest assets \- our people. You will hold the keys to our company’s scale focusing on fostering a high\-performance culture, integrating smart HR technology, and ensuring our talent pipeline remains resilient in an evolving GCC market. You will partner directly with our senior leadership team and HR leadership in building the teams that will ship and shape our next generation of solutions creating long lasting positive impact to our customers. If you thrive to navigate a complex transition: moving from traditional administration to becoming a digital\-first, strategic business architect in a competitive market and want to see your fingerprints on the growth of a high\-speed purpose driven organization, this is your seat at the table.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities
* Strategic Business Partnering (HRBP)
* Stakeholder Management: Act as a strategic consultant to Department Heads to align people strategies with P\&L goals.
* Organizational Design: Lead OD\&S exercises to ensure lean, agile teams that support market demands and our growth.
* Workforce Planning: Use predictive analytics to manage headcount budget and "Build vs. Buy" talent decisions.
* 2\. Talent \& Leadership Development
* High\-Potential (HiPo) Programs: Identify and groom "Next\-Gen" leaders through structured mentorship and executive coaching.
* Succession Planning: Build a robust leadership pipeline for C\-suite and critical technical roles.
* Continuous Learning: Transition from "One\-off Training" to a "Culture of Learning" using AI\-driven platforms and micro\-learning modules.
* 3\. HR Transformation Projects
* AI Native HR function: Implement AI in our functions processes, workflows, tools and procedures.
* Change Management: Guide the organization through cultural shifts, including hybrid work transitions and digital\-first workflows.
* 4\. Total Rewards \& Compensation
* Structure Design: Design and manage competitive salary benchmarks, including Fixed Pay, Variable Pay, and Long\-Term Incentives.
* Benefits Strategy: Implement benefits, flexible insurance, and wellness credits.
* Annual Cycles: Manage the end\-to\-end Appraisal and Merit Increase process with data\-backed transparency.
* 5\. Indian Employment Law \& Compliance
* New Labor Codes: Ensure 100% readiness and compliance with the 4 New Labour Codes (Social Security, Industrial Relations, Wages, and OSH).
* Statutory Oversight: Oversee PF, ESI, PT, and Gratuity management.
* POSH \& Ethics: Act as a key member/advisor to the Internal Committee (IC) to ensure a safe, inclusive workplace.
* 6\. Employee Experience \& Culture: Lead initiatives to improve employee engagement, retention, and well\-being. Champion a diverse, equitable, and inclusive (DEI) workplace.
* Performance \& Development: Manage the annual performance review cycle. Identify skill gaps and implement "continuous learning" programs to facilitate rapid upskilling.

* Strong understanding of HR practices, employment laws, and industry trends. Ability to influence and work with senior leadership.

description:
**About Shinkly**

Shinkly Private Limited is a software company building modern SaaS products, including Voidfull \- https://voidfull.com (all\-in\-one content management) and LogChimp \- https://logchimp.app (customer feedback collection).

We focus on building high\-quality, product\-led software and scaling these products to a global audience. As an early\-stage startup, we believe in experimentation, learning quickly, and working closely together to build meaningful products.

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a **highly driven fresher** who has completed **at least 3 months of internship in tech and sales** and wants to build a serious career in B2B SaaS.

This is not a “lead gen” role — you’ll get **exposure to the full sales cycle**, working directly with the founder to generate pipeline, talk to prospects, and contribute to closing deals.

If you’re curious, hungry, and willing to learn by doing — this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify and research potential customers (startups, SaaS teams, founders)
* Reach out via cold email, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels
* Qualify inbound and outbound leads
* Conduct initial discovery calls to understand customer pain points
* Support demos and follow\-ups with prospects
* Maintain CRM and track sales pipeline consistently
* Work closely with the founder on messaging, positioning, and GTM experiments
* Share insights from conversations to improve product and sales strategy

**Who Should Apply**

* Fresher with minimum 3 months internship experience in tech and sales
* Strong communication skills (written \+ verbal)
* Comfortable talking to new people and handling rejection
* Self\-starter who can work in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment
* Curious mindset — willing to learn sales by actually doing it
* Basic understanding of SaaS or B2B products

**Good to Have (Not Mandatory)**

* Experience with cold emailing / LinkedIn outreach
* Exposure to CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, etc.)
* Experience working in a startup or remote team
* Understanding of Product\-Led Growth (PLG)

**What You’ll Get**

* Structured hands\-on training in real SaaS sales execution
* Opportunity to work directly with the founder
* Learn full sales cycle — from prospecting to closing
* Practical exposure to outbound sales, CRM workflows, and customer conversations
* Fast growth based on performance and consistency
* Flexible, remote\-friendly work environment
* Potential transition into a full\-time high\-paying sales role

**Compensation Structure**

Our compensation model is designed for candidates who are confident in their ability to generate pipeline and close deals. To reward performance with strong earning potential and a clear pathway to a fixed base salary.

As part of this process, selected candidates are required to submit a refundable onboarding and training commitment deposit of ₹5,000 INR before starting. The commitment deposit is refunded on a milestone\-based prorated basis during the ramp\-up phase

Phase 1: Ramp\-Up (Commission\-Driven)

* 20% of subscription revenue every month *(starting from the second month)*
* ₹3000 INR bonus on your first deal worth more than $50 USD
* ₹500 INR guarantee for every new deal you close
* No cap on earnings.

This phase gives you a high upside from day one and helps us identify strong performers quickly.

Phase 2: Base Salary \+ Commission

* Unlock a base salary of ₹20,000 INR/month after generating a minimum of $300 USD MRR
* Continued 5–10% upsell commissions
* Future increments possible based on consistent performance

Why This Structure

As an early\-stage startup, we invest heavily in hands\-on onboarding, mentorship, and practical training while giving high\-performers a fast path to guaranteed income. Strong performers typically unlock Phase 2 quickly.

description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
 At Xerox,
 **we make work, work!**

From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients and within our culture.  Job Title
   

  

 Network Engineer
   

  

 Job Description:
   

  

 Our technology is outstanding, but it’s the talented, diverse, and driven people behind our company who make it all happen. Our employees have the determination to go further, the adaptability to adjust to an ever\-changing global market, the heart to stay passionate and personally invested, and the mind to know when to step back and put it all in perspective.
   

  

 Lexmark (A Subsidiary of Xerox Corporation) is in search of a seasoned network operations engineer with a passion for operating, executing, and enhancing standard processes for maintaining an enterprise network. The selected candidate will collaborate with multiple teams to ensure the implementation of IT operations, security, and network policies. The role involves working with architecture and business teams to ensure the availability of the enterprise network. The engineer will also be responsible for monitoring tool efficiency, setting guidelines, and eliminating barriers to achieve desired outcomes. Additionally, they will liaise with other IT operation teams to resolve any network\-related issues. The ideal candidate must possess robust communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:
   

  

 Remote Administration and troubleshooting of switches, routers, firewalls, and cloud networks.
   

  

 Configuration and management of multiple network security systems to include next gen firewalls, unified threat management services, and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
   

  

 Deployment of public cloud network services including virtual networks, load balancers, web application firewalls, and virtual gateways.
   

  

 Execution of standard network delivery processes such as VLAN creation, route advertisements, firewall policy configurations, DNS record changes, IPAM network creation, network performance reports, network infrastructure hardening, software/hardware licensing, and virtual network peering.
   

  

 Coordination of high\-impact infrastructure changes and outages during on and off\-hours.
   

  

 Collaboration with architecture teams providing design feedback, process improvement opportunities, and potential solution enhancements.
   

  

 Act as the escalation contact for the network helpdesk and incident managers.
   

  

 Communicate regularly with management and architecture teams on operational metrics.
   

  

 Light travel will be required to meet with international teams.
   

  

 Hands on support for the deployment of new infrastructure and maintenance of existing infrastructure at the company headquarters location.
   

  

 Be an advocate and change leader for network\-security initiatives and operational processes with a goal of improving the overall culture.
   

  

**Must\-have Qualifications, Skills, Experience**
 Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or related field with 3\-5 years of networking and security experience.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of LAN, WAN, VLAN, Public Cloud, Wireless, and VoIP networking technologies.
   

  

 Advance knowledge of routing protocols to include Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), and Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP).
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of network security concepts, including web filters, NIDPS, DLP, SSL\-DPI, firewalls, etc.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of network services, including DNS, DHCP, IPAM, SNMP, IPSec, NetFlow.
   

  

 Knowledge of Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Network Access Control (NAC) technologies.
   

  

 Knowledge of scripting, automation, and DevOps functions including Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and Configuration\-as\-Code (CaC).
   

  

 Experience working with Fortinet, Cisco, InfoBlox, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies.
   

  

 Experience with client facing Network Operations Center (NOC) support.
   

  

 Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Experience with ITSM, ITIL, NIST, CIS, and ISO 27001 frameworks.
   

  

 Proven ability to lead and manage multiple priorities with proven organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks with changing priorities.
   

  

 Experience with working with onshore and offshore global teams.
   

  

 Strong ability in multiple technologies, analytical techniques, and leadership skills.
   

  

 In\-depth knowledge of Operational Processes (Event, Incident, Change, Problem).
   

  

 Preferred Certifications:
   

  

 Microsoft Azure Certifications (AZ\-900, AZ\-700, AZ\-500, AZ\-204\)
   

  

 CompTIA \+ Certifications (Network\+, Security\+)
   

  

 Cisco Certifications (CCNA, CCNP)
   

  

**Educational Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
   

  

**Years Of Experience In This Field**
 3 to 7 years of experience as a Network Engineer in a global company.

 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

 Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go\-to person for second\-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
   

  

 You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Location: Noida, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

 As a Technical Writer for the Software Monetization team, you will be part of a dynamic software engineering team working on several products. You will be working in an Agile environment collaborating closely with the engineering team, with minimum supervision. Your primary role will be to create and edit technical product documentation, such as developer guides, user manuals, web service guides, API reference manuals, installation manuals, help documents, and tutorials. You will need to effectively plan, schedule, research, and write.
   

  

**A week in the life of a Technical Writer:**
* Define target audience, outline manuals, and write documentation that is technically accurate and conforms to company's writing style guidelines.
* Document new features and maintain existing documentation, including online helps and PDFs.
* Work closely with developers, product architects, and product owners to create technical documentation with a high focus on clarity, completeness, accuracy, and usability.
* Obtain product information from agile meetings, specifications, supplemental material, and discussions with project engineers.
* Participate in peer review processes to improve documentation quality.
* Contribute to develop and maintain existing documentation processes, standards, checklists, and templates.
* Suggest screen labels and error messages with a focus on improving the customer experience (UX).
* Create graphics to supplement flow and presentation of the content.
* Help in translation and localization processes.


**Knowledge, Skills and Experience:**

**Description**
 Join VS Analytics to transform seller verification data into insights that power Amazon's global marketplace. As a Business Analyst I, you'll build dashboards and provide analytics that help product teams improve the registration and verification experience for millions of sellers worldwide.
   

  

 You'll work within established frameworks to deliver tactical analytics solutions using SQL and Amazon Quick. Your analyses will support team metrics and business decisions, helping stakeholders understand seller registration funnels, verification processes, and ready\-to\-launch metrics across the Registration and Verification Services organization.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Build and maintain SQL queries and Amazon Quick dashboards to support business needs
   

  

 Work with stakeholders to gather requirements for straightforward analytics projects
   

  

 Develop understanding of VS Analytics data sources to solve defined business problems
   

  

 Design datasets that provide timely access to actionable business information
   

  

 Perform analyses to identify opportunities in registration and verification processes
   

  

 Create performance dashboards with key metrics for team review
   

  

 Handle multiple concurrent requests, prioritizing with guidance from senior team members
   

  

 Document analytical approaches including metric definitions, logic, and data sources
   

  

 Help train new peers on team processes and tools
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning starts checking overnight dashboard refreshes and reviewing any data issues flagged by the team. You write SQL queries to analyze verification funnel metrics for a product feature launch, consulting with senior analysts when you encounter unfamiliar data sources. Mid\-day, you gather requirements in stakeholder meetings, asking clarifying questions about new metrics they need tracked. You spend the afternoon updating Amazon Quick dashboards based on feedback, testing changes to ensure accuracy. Throughout the day, you balance multiple tactical requests \- from ad\-hoc data pulls to dashboard maintenance \- while documenting your analytical approaches in the team wiki. You wrap up preparing questions for office hours about a more complex analysis you're starting, continuously learning from your team while delivering insights that support business decisions.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The VS Analytics team consists of 12 BA/BIE spread across multiple time zones. Our mission is to improve seller verification services through data, analytics, and insights. We operate with a vision to build a better business with analytics, data, and AI products.
   

  

 We work in biweekly sprints, hold regular office hours for stakeholders, and maintain a ticketing system for support requests. The team emphasizes knowledge sharing, with opportunities to learn from senior analysts guided by Amazon's 16 Leadership Principles and contribute to our self\-service analytics initiatives.
   

  

 Here at Selling Partner Services, we embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We are reaching 10,000\+ employees globally.

 Are you passionate about working with Amazon\-scale systems, solving critical engineering problems, and delivering mission critical solutions? Does the idea of building end\-to\-end solutions that will delight Selling Partners excite you? If yes, then we want to talk with you.
   

  

 Vendor Experience Team is looking for a dynamic engineer to join our programmatic experiences team, to deliver world\-class solutions that delights our Selling Partners and Solution Providers. Selling Partners depend on us to provide robust and scalable APIs to help them automate, manage and grow their business. We are looking for Engineers with a strong sense of ownership and a passion for delivering creative solutions for complex problems on an unprecedented scale. As part of the team, you will have a significant impact on our systems, our business and most importantly, our customers, and build solutions that will achieve our vision of industry\-leading API parity with our interactive experiences. Successful candidates will be innovative, flexible, self\-directed, and able to design and write high\-performance, reliable, maintainable code. They must also be able to design and develop innovative GenAI powered solutions to accelerate time to market. The ability to function at a very high level in a fast\-paced environment along with a team of very talented engineers is essential. If you enjoy working in a dynamic environment to deliver world class mission critical systems, this may be the career opportunity for you!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Collaborate with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
* Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
* Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault\-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
* Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
* Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
* Translate functional requirements into robust, scalable, supportable solutions that work well within the overall system architecture.
* Participate in the full development cycle, end\-to\-end, from design, implementation, and testing to documentation, delivery and maintenance.
* Produce comprehensive, usable software documentation.
* Evaluate and make decisions around the use of new or existing software products and tools.
* Work in an agile environment to deliver high\-quality software.
* Mentor junior development engineers.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- ADCI \- Karnataka
